purpose: Public-program eligibility evidence only. No account-specific entitlement is claimed and no resource creation is authorized.

observed_public_limits.ampere_a1_monthly_free_allowance: 1500 OCPU-hours and 9000 GB-hours; current Always Free documentation equates this to 2 OCPUs and 12 GB RAM total

material_risks: Always Free compute capacity can be temporarily unavailable in the home region.
Oracle documents reclamation of idle Always Free compute instances when CPU and network utilization stay below 20% over a 7-day period; A1 also applies a memory-utilization threshold.
Account home region, remaining Always Free quotas, current shape capacity, and billing state are not observable from public documentation.
promotion_blockers: idle-reclamation disposition not yet proven acceptable
zero-cost resource selection not yet machine-checked

observed_public_limits.compute: one non-preemptible e2-micro VM per month within the eligible-hour allowance

material_risks: 1 GB RAM is materially tighter than Oracle A1 for a Node 22 Independent Node + gateway + TLS edge.
1 GB/month outbound transfer is a small public-service envelope and overage/billing posture must be proven fail-closed.
Billing-account state, free-tier consumption, quota, and regional VM availability are not observable from public documentation.
promotion_blockers: 1 GB RAM sufficiency not yet reproduced on real host
egress overage guard not yet proven
zero-cost resource selection not yet machine-checked

decision.reason: Neither public program description alone is sufficient to prove an eligible persistent host.
